_comment: Four factory-sealed quick bots (#61). Chassis/drive mass, core, size, speed and grip live in mvp_parts.json; this file locks each chassis to its loadout and tunes its gait. Authoritative gameplay data read by server simulation and client prediction through NimbleBots: changing any value is a gameplay change (bump WireCodec.BUILD). Distances are game metres in the hull frame (X right, Y up, -Z forward; the factor-three runtime scale is already applied), speeds m/s, angles degrees, times seconds.

support._comment: Hover support shared by every gait. Down rays under the footholds find the floor; a damped spring holds the hull centre ride_height above the highest one (bots do not stand on their thin legs, wheel or spring). Tall bots add a solid leg_collision box under the hull with the hull's footprint, ending well above the floor, so an arena wall meets a flat face (a hull edge would ride up over the wall top) and a pogo cannot bound over it; the monowheel adds its tyre cylinder. Each bot's reach is how far below the hull its running gear can touch the floor (legs outstretched, tyre, pads fully extended), so the spring only carries a hull whose gear stands on the floor, never one hovering above it (#75). A bounded torque keeps the hull aligned with the floor plus the gait's lean. lift_headroom is the upward acceleration the spring may add beyond carrying the heft weight.

practice._comment: Offline practice roamers: in the listed arenas the four bots start on a ring (home_radius_fraction of the arena half extent) facing the centre, race patrol loops of patrol_points around their homes at patrol_throttle, and engage the player inside engage_distance with the ordinary pilot.

strider_09._comment: Camouflaged reverse-knee biped with a hammer arm. Stride gait: the stride surges the target speed once per step (push-off then swing) and bobs and sways the hull with each footfall (the legs may lift by lift_headroom beyond the heft weight to follow the bob); pivots quickly on the spot.
strider_09.name: STRIDER • 09

monowheel_07._comment: Red monowheel with a minigun. Roll gait: the fastest bot; it leans into turns like a rider (lean = atan(lateral acceleration / 9.8), scaled and capped), pitches with throttle, grips its tyre through the carve (a looser lateral_response let the tyre skid sideways, #75), and barely turns on the spot (pivot_fraction of full turn rate until full_turn_speed).
monowheel_07.name: HELLWHEEL • 07
monowheel_07._ride_comment: The hull rides on its tyre: ride_height is the upright contact depth (wheel centre_y below the hull plus the tyre radius) plus wheel.clearance, and GaitDrive lowers it as the hull leans and pitches (the rounded tyre profile rises off the floor), so the tyre stays on the floor (#75: it hovered up to 0.9 m). reach ends just past that contact, so the spring catches a landing only as the tyre meets the floor.
monowheel_07._wheel_comment: profile: the tyre's half cross-section as [axial offset from the mid-plane, radius] pairs (game metres), the convex envelope measured from the modelled lugged tyre (flat crown, rounded shoulders). It is revolved into the tyre collider and gives the contact depth as the hull leans.
monowheel_07._low_gravity_comment: Weighs low_gravity_heft times arena gravity where heft does not apply (the Moon), so it keeps its wheel on the ground; jump and rise limits scale with it like heft.

roll._carve_comment: Turn rate is capped so the turn's centripetal acceleration stays within this share of the tyre grip; the rest of the grip holds the line, so the tyre carves instead of skidding.

pogo_03._comment: Yellow pogo on a coil spring over a tripod. Hop gait: while driving it bounds; after stance time on the spring it launches at hop_speed (1 g equivalent, scaled like jumps) carrying the driven speed forward; on the floor its pads grip (stance_grip) instead of skidding; in the air it turns at air_turn_rate and trims its heading speed by air_acceleration. The spring lands it with landing_headroom of extra lift.
pogo_03.name: POGO • 03
pogo_03._reach_comment: reach is ride_height plus the tripod's full extension (the visual hub drops 0.6 m below rest): the spring takes the hull exactly as the pads touch, never while they dangle above the floor.

hop._stance_comment: While the tripod stands on the floor its pads grip: planar velocity and yaw decay at stance_grip (1/s) and the motor does not drive, so the pads never skid (#75); the next launch carries the driven speed (carry) and the pogo steers in the air.

skater_12._comment: Red four-legged skater on leg-end wheels with twin cannons. Skate gait: alternating kick strokes (push_seconds of each stroke_seconds) drive it; between kicks it glides on glide_drive of its motor with a very low coast drag, carving hard with a modest lean and crouching as it speeds up.
skater_12.name: SKATER • 12
